# Castallio One

> Castallio One is an AEC (architecture, engineering and construction) network and hiring platform in India. It lists jobs in BIM, civil, structural, MEP, mechanical, electrical, architecture and construction management across Indian states and cities.

## Facts
- Open jobs listed: 6
- Last updated: 2026-10-30
- Coverage: 36 states and union territories, up to 10 cities each
- Website: https://castallioone.com

## Jobs by state
- [Maharashtra](https://castallioone.com/jobs/maharashtra/): 6 jobs
